sources.title: Model Merging: A Survey - by Cameron R. Wolfe, Ph.D.
sources.snippet: After a certain (reasonable) amount of training, all networks obtained from the same base model are linearly mode connected. As we will see, this finding is highly related to model merging, as we typically merge models by averaging or interpolating their weights.
